YOLO-pineapple: enhanced pineapple detection in UAV images using an optimized YOLOv8 model
YOLO-菠萝：基于优化 YOLOv8 模型的无人机图像中菠萝增强检测

Abstract  摘要

Accurate pre-harvest yield estimation is fundamental to pineapple production, as it facilitates optimized harvest scheduling, informs market-responsive pricing strategies, and supports data-driven decision-making in smart agriculture. The rapid advancement of object detection algorithms, coupled with the deployment of miniaturized cameras on Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) platforms, has made high-throughput pineapple counting for precise yield estimation increasingly feasible. Nonetheless, accurate detection of pineapples in UAV imagery remains challenging due to factors such as the small size of individual fruits, significant scale variations, and complex background textures, all of which impede precise localization and identification. To address these challenges, the present study introduces a novel object detection framework, termed YOLO-Pineapple, designed for accurate pineapple detection in high-resolution color images captured by UAVs. YOLO-Pineapple enhances the baseline YOLOv8 model through several key innovations: (1) the Dynamic Interactive Task Alignment Head (DITAH) is proposed to resolve feature inconsistency and task misalignment between localization and classification branches by integrating interactive and independent features, thereby improving detection accuracy; (2) the incorporation of the Grouped Multi-Scale Convolution (GMSC) module reduces redundant feature computations while capturing richer multi-scale features, enhancing performance in cluttered and heavily occluded field environments; (3) the introduction of the Spatial and Channel Synergistic Attention (SCSA) mechanism facilitates enhanced semantic feature interaction via the combined application of multi-semantic spatial attention and channel self-attention; and (4) the integration of a sample-adaptive weighting mechanism derived from Focaler-IoU with the angle-aware distance component of SIoU culminates in a novel loss function, designated Focaler_SIoU, which achieves more precise bounding box regression, particularly for small objects. Experimental evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed YOLO-Pineapple model, which attains a mean average precision (mAP) of 94.4%, a Recall rate of 88.9%, and a precision of 94.6%. The optimized YOLO-Pineapple algorithm constitutes a significant advancement in overcoming the challenges associated with pineapple detection from UAV imagery, while exhibiting promising potential for yield estimation and pineapple field management.
准确的采前产量估算是菠萝生产的基础，有助于优化采收计划、制定市场响应型定价策略，并为智慧农业中的数据驱动决策提供支持。随着目标检测算法的快速发展，结合无人机平台搭载微型摄像头的部署，基于高通量菠萝计数实现精准产量估算的可行性日益增强。然而，由于单个果实体积小、尺度差异显著以及复杂背景纹理等因素，无人机影像中菠萝的精准检测仍面临挑战，这些因素均阻碍了精确的定位与识别。 为应对上述挑战，本研究提出了一种名为 YOLO-Pineapple 的新型目标检测框架，专门用于无人机高分辨率彩色图像中菠萝的精准检测。该框架通过以下关键创新对基线 YOLOv8 模型进行了优化：(1) 提出动态交互式任务对齐头（DITAH），通过融合交互特征与独立特征，解决定位分支与分类分支间的特征不一致及任务错位问题，从而提升检测精度；(2) 引入分组多尺度卷积模块（GMSC），在减少冗余特征计算的同时捕获更丰富的多尺度特征，增强复杂遮挡田间环境下的检测性能；(3) 设计空间与通道协同注意力机制（SCSA），通过多语义空间注意力与通道自注意力的联合应用，促进语义特征交互；(4) 将基于 Focaler-IoU 的样本自适应加权机制与 SIoU 的角度感知距离分量相结合，构建新型损失函数。 命名为 Focaler_SIoU，该损失函数实现了更精确的边界框回归，尤其适用于小目标检测。实验评估证明了所提出的 YOLO-Pineapple 模型的有效性，其平均精度均值（mAP）达到 94.4%，召回率为 88.9%，精确率为 94.6%。优化后的 YOLO-Pineapple 算法在克服无人机影像中菠萝检测相关挑战方面取得了显著进展，同时在产量估算和菠萝田间管理方面展现出良好的应用潜力。

1. Introduction  1. 引言

Pineapple (Ananas comosus (L.) Merr.) is a high-value tropical fruit crop and holds a prominent position in China's fruit industry. The cultivation area exceeds 66,700 ha, with an annual production surpassing two million tons (Shen et al., 2025, Shiu et al., 2023). Accurate estimation of pineapple yield is critically important for optimizing harvest scheduling, supply chain management, and facilitating data-driven market decisions (Apolo-Apolo et al., 2020, Bali and Singla, 2022). Nevertheless, current methodologies predominantly depend on labor-intensive manual counting and recording processes, which are time-consuming, prone to errors, and impractical for large-scale agricultural operations (Oikonomidis et al., 2023). Recent advancements in deep learning techniques, coupled with the widespread deployment of UAV, present promising opportunities for high-throughput, automated pineapple counting through the analysis of high-resolution aerial imagery (Chen et al., 2025, Farjon et al., 2023; Kuiye Ding et al., 2024).
菠萝（Ananas comosus (L.) Merr.）是一种高价值热带水果作物，在中国水果产业中占据重要地位。其种植面积超过 6.67 万公顷，年产量突破 200 万吨（Shen 等，2025；Shiu 等，2023）。准确估算菠萝产量对于优化采收计划、供应链管理以及促进数据驱动的市场决策至关重要（Apolo-Apolo 等，2020；Bali 和 Singla，2022）。然而，当前方法主要依赖劳动密集型的人工计数和记录流程，不仅耗时费力、易出错，且难以适用于大规模农业作业（Oikonomidis 等，2023）。近年来深度学习技术的进步，结合无人机（UAV）的广泛部署，为通过分析高分辨率航拍图像实现高通量、自动化的菠萝计数提供了广阔前景（Chen 等，2025；Farjon 等，2023；Kuiye Ding 等，2024）。
The precise detection of pineapples is a fundamental prerequisite for efficient and reliable yield estimation. However, several challenges complicate accurate pineapple detection in UAV imagery: (a) the complex natural field environment, characterized by variable illumination and canopy self-shadowing, adversely affects image quality and diminishes model generalizability (Wang et al., 2024a, Wang et al., 2024b); (b) the relatively small size of individual fruits, which at typical flight altitudes of 20 to 60 m occupy only a few dozen pixels, with projected sizes varying significantly due to canopy morphology and camera perspective. Additionally, image down-sampling can result in the loss of these sparse signals, thereby complicating precise detection and localization (Velumani et al., 2021); and (c) substantial occlusion and visual similarity, where leaves, branches, or weeds partially obscure pineapples, and the scaly rind of the fruit closely resembles that of the surrounding foliage in both color and texture, thereby blurring class boundaries and hindering reliable detection (Du et al., 2023, Yang et al., 2025, Yang et al., 2025). Collectively, these factors impair the performance of pineapple detection models, consequently limiting the efficacy of UAV-based approaches for accurate yield estimation.
菠萝的精准检测是实现高效可靠产量估算的基本前提。然而，无人机影像中的菠萝准确检测面临多重挑战：(a) 复杂的自然田间环境——光照多变与冠层自阴影——会降低图像质量并削弱模型泛化能力（Wang 等，2024a；Wang 等，2024b）；(b) 单个果实尺寸较小，在 20 至 60 米典型飞行高度下仅占据数十像素，且因冠层形态与相机视角差异，其投影尺寸变化显著。 此外，图像下采样可能导致这些稀疏信号的丢失，从而增加精确检测与定位的难度（Velumani 等，2021）；以及（c）严重的遮挡与视觉相似性问题——叶片、枝条或杂草部分遮挡菠萝，且果实鳞状外皮在颜色和纹理上与周围叶片高度相似，从而模糊了类别边界，阻碍了可靠检测（Du 等，2023；Yang 等，2025；Yang 等，2025）。综合而言，这些因素削弱了菠萝检测模型的性能，进而限制了基于无人机方法在精准产量估算中的有效性。
To address these challenges, research has progressively shifted from conventional image processing frameworks toward deep learning-based detection methods (Akdoğan et al., 2025, Badgujar et al., 2024). Traditional object detection approaches typically commence with the extraction of image features such as texture, color, and shape, which are subsequently classified using classical machine learning algorithms including Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) (Thai et al., 2025). For example, Wan Nurazwin Syazwani et al., (2022) reported an accuracy of 94.4% in detecting pineapple crowns from UAV-acquired RGB images by combining CLAHE-enhanced HSV segmentation with a multilayer perceptron classifier, utilizing color, shape, and texture features selected through ANOVA. Despite the effectiveness of traditional object detection algorithms in certain controlled contexts, their reliance on manually engineered, environment-specific features significantly constrains their generalizability and robustness, leading to suboptimal performance in complex natural settings.
为应对这些挑战，研究已逐步从传统图像处理框架转向基于深度学习的检测方法（Akdoğan 等，2025；Badgujar 等，2024）。传统目标检测方法通常先提取纹理、颜色和形状等图像特征，再通过随机森林（RF）、支持向量机（SVM）和 K 近邻（KNN）等经典机器学习算法进行分类（Thai 等，2025）。例如，Wan Nurazwin Syazwani 等人（2022）通过将 CLAHE 增强的 HSV 分割与多层感知器分类器相结合，利用方差分析筛选的颜色、形状和纹理特征，在无人机获取的 RGB 图像中检测菠萝冠芽时实现了 94.4%的准确率。尽管传统目标检测算法在特定受控环境中表现有效，但其依赖人工设计的、环境特异性特征的特性显著限制了泛化能力和鲁棒性，导致在复杂自然场景中性能欠佳。
Recent progress in deep learning has significantly propelled the development of numerous efficient models tailored for UAV-based vegetation monitoring (Osco et al., 2021, Zhang et al., 2020). Contemporary deep learning object detectors are generally categorized into two main types: two-stage detectors, such as R-CNN and its derivatives, and single-stage detectors, with the You Only Look Once (YOLO) family being a prominent example (Badgujar et al., 2024, Zhang et al., 2023). For example, Mahmud et al., (2023) automated detection in complex orchard environments by integrating UAV multispectral imagery with ground-based RGB images, calculating the modified ratio vegetation index, classifying unhealthy canopies via a support vector machine, and subsequently employing Mask R-CNN for detection and segmentation of apple fire blight, achieving Precision and Recall rates of 92.8% and 91.2%, respectively. While two-stage detectors have shown promising results in fruit detection tasks, single-stage detectors from the YOLO series have gained wider adoption due to their favorable balance between model complexity and real-time processing capabilities. Akdoğan et al., (2025) introduced an enhanced and preprocessed YOLO (PP-YOLO) model incorporating histogram equalization and wavelet-transform preprocessing to improve transitions among tree branches, leaves, and ground surfaces and to reduce noise in UAV imagery; by integrating a spatial attention module, this approach attained F1 and mAP50 scores of 95.8% and 98.3%, respectively, in detecting apple and cherry trees. Yu et al., (2025) developed the FEL-YOLOv8 model to automatically estimate soybean seedling emergence, missing seedlings, and growth uniformity, achieving average precision (AP) values of 0.979 for seedling detection and 0.99 for plot-oriented bounding boxes. In contrast to the broader scope of UAV-based vegetation detection, research focusing specifically on pineapple detection using UAV imagery remains limited, with only a few recent contributions. Lin et al., (2025) proposed the DPD-YOLO model, which incorporates a coordinate attention mechanism to enhance feature extraction of pineapples in cluttered backgrounds, integrates a dedicated small-target detection layer with a bi-directional feature pyramid network (BiFPN) for multi-scale feature enhancement, and employs an RT-DETR transformer head to improve detection accuracy. However, the model’s performance was constrained by the limited size of the training dataset, which comprised only 153 UAV imagery from a single region, resulting in Precision and Recall rates of 86.2% and 62.0%, respectively.
深度学习的最新进展显著推动了众多专为无人机植被监测设计的高效模型的发展（Osco 等，2021；Zhang 等，2020）。当代深度学习目标检测器通常分为两大类：两阶段检测器（如 R-CNN 及其衍生模型）和单阶段检测器，其中 YOLO（You Only Look Once）系列是典型代表（Badgujar 等，2024；Zhang 等，2023）。例如，Mahmud 等（2023）通过整合无人机多光谱影像与地面 RGB 图像，计算修正比值植被指数，利用支持向量机分类不健康树冠，随后采用 Mask R-CNN 检测和分割苹果火疫病，实现了复杂果园环境中的自动化检测，精确率和召回率分别达到 92.8%和 91.2%。尽管两阶段检测器在水果检测任务中展现出良好效果，但 YOLO 系列的单阶段检测器因其在模型复杂度与实时处理能力之间的理想平衡而获得更广泛的应用。 Akdoğan 等人（2025）提出了一种增强型预处理 YOLO（PP-YOLO）模型，该模型结合直方图均衡化与小波变换预处理技术，以改善无人机影像中树枝、叶片与地面之间的过渡效果并降低噪声；通过集成空间注意力模块，该方法在检测苹果树和樱桃树时分别取得了 95.8%的 F1 分数和 98.3%的 mAP50 值。Yu 等人（2025）开发了 FEL-YOLOv8 模型，用于自动估算大豆出苗率、缺苗情况及生长均匀度，在幼苗检测和地块导向边界框检测中分别达到了 0.979 和 0.99 的平均精度（AP）值。相较于基于无人机的植被检测这一更广泛的研究领域，专门针对无人机影像中菠萝检测的研究仍十分有限，仅有少数近期成果。 Lin 等人（2025）提出的 DPD-YOLO 模型，通过引入坐标注意力机制增强复杂背景下菠萝的特征提取能力，集成专用小目标检测层与双向特征金字塔网络（BiFPN）实现多尺度特征增强，并采用 RT-DETR 变换器头部提升检测精度。然而，该模型性能受限于训练数据集规模——仅包含来自单一区域的 153 张无人机影像，导致其精确率和召回率分别仅为 86.2%和 62.0%。
Despite the proliferation of UAV-based deep learning detectors for crop detection, task-specific methodologies for high-throughput pineapple detection via UAV platforms remain scarce. To address these challenges, the present study developed a specialized object detector, YOLO-Pineapple. By expanding dataset diversity and optimizing the model architecture, the proposed approach achieves accurate and robust detection performance.
尽管基于无人机平台的深度学习检测器在作物检测领域日益普及，但针对通过无人机平台实现高通量菠萝检测的特定任务方法仍然稀缺。为应对这些挑战，本研究开发了一种专用目标检测器——YOLO-Pineapple。通过扩展数据集多样性并优化模型架构，所提出的方法实现了准确且鲁棒的检测性能。
The main contributions of this work are as follows:
本研究的主要贡献如下：
  • a)
    To enhance the accuracy of pineapple detection and the precision of localization under complex field conditions, a novel Dynamic Interactive Task Alignment Head (DITAH) was developed to supplant the original YOLOv8 detection head. By integrating task decomposition modules, DITAH independently learns features pertinent to localization and classification. This architectural design effectively mitigates feature conflicts and task misalignment, thereby improving the overall performance of the model.
    为提升复杂田间条件下菠萝检测的准确性与定位精度，开发了一种新型动态交互任务对齐头（DITAH）以替代原始 YOLOv8 检测头。通过集成任务分解模块，DITAH 能够独立学习与定位和分类相关的特征。该架构设计有效缓解了特征冲突与任务错位问题，从而提升了模型的整体性能。
  • b)
    To address the challenges arising from the color similarity between pineapple leaves and crowns, as well as the difficulties associated with detecting small targets, the Grouped Multi-Scale Convolution (GMSC) module was incorporated. GMSC utilizes group convolution to extract multi-scale features, which prevents the loss of small-object information following successive convolutional operations. Additionally, the inclusion of the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) enables the model to suppress background noise and concentrate on salient pineapple features.
    为解决菠萝叶片与冠层颜色相似以及小目标检测困难的问题，引入了分组多尺度卷积（GMSC）模块。该模块通过分组卷积提取多尺度特征，有效防止了连续卷积操作后小目标信息的丢失。同时，卷积块注意力模块（CBAM）的加入使模型能够抑制背景噪声，聚焦于显著的菠萝特征。
  • c)
    To further augment detection accuracy in high-density scenarios, the SCSA mechanism was integrated into the YOLOv8 architecture. This synergistic approach preserves comprehensive feature information by circumventing channel compression, thereby enhancing the model’s capacity to discern overlapping pineapple targets.
    为进一步提升高密度场景下的检测精度，将 SCSA 机制集成到 YOLOv8 架构中。这种协同方法通过避免通道压缩来保留完整的特征信息，从而增强了模型识别重叠菠萝目标的能力。
  • d)
    Finally, the Focaler_SIoU loss function was proposed to refine bounding box regression. This loss function combines the sample-adaptive weighting strategy of Focaler-IoU with the angle-aware distance component of SIoU. The Focaler-IoU element enhances learning on challenging samples, such as occluded and small pineapples, while the SIoU component introduces an angular penalty that accelerates regression convergence and improves localization accuracy.
    最后，提出了 Focaler_SIoU 损失函数以优化边界框回归。该损失函数结合了 Focaler-IoU 的样本自适应加权策略与 SIoU 的角度感知距离分量。Focaler-IoU 元素增强了对遮挡和小菠萝等困难样本的学习能力，而 SIoU 分量引入的角度惩罚项加速了回归收敛并提升了定位精度。
The remainder of this paper is organized as follows: Section 2 details the experimental settings, principles, and framework of the improved YOLO-Pineapple. Section 3 presents the detailed result of this method. Lastly, Section 4 gives the discussion, conclusions and future prospects.
本文其余部分组织如下：第 2 节详细介绍了实验设置、原理及改进型 YOLO-Pineapple 的框架；第 3 节展示了该方法的具体结果；最后，第 4 节进行了讨论、总结并展望了未来研究方向。

2. Materials and methods  2. 材料与方法

2.1. Research area and data acquisition
2.1. 研究区域与数据采集

The present study was carried out at a pineapple cultivation site located in Xuwen County, Zhanjiang City, Guangdong Province, China (approximately 20°26′N, 110°10′E), as illustrated in Fig. 1(a). Xuwen, recognized as a principal pineapple-producing region in China, exhibits a tropical monsoon humid climate characterized by elevated temperatures, substantial precipitation, and abundant sunshine during the dry season. These climatic conditions are conducive to the production of pineapples with high yield and superior quality. The experimental period covered September 25–29, 2025, during which pineapples were at the early fruiting stage (Fig. 1(b)) under varying ambient light conditions. Data collection was performed using a DJI Phantom 4 RTK UAV equipped with a camera featuring a 1-inch FC6310 CMOS sensor and a 24 mm equivalent focal length, f/2.8 wide-angle lens, capable of capturing RGB images at a resolution of 5280 × 3956 pixels, as depicted in Fig. 1(c). Notably, data acquisition was conducted via manual UAV operation, without using pre-programmed flight trajectories. Throughout image capture, the UAV maintained a stable hover at altitudes ranging from 5 to 15 m above ground level (AGL), with the onboard camera consistently oriented in the nadir position. The resulting images, exemplified in Fig. 1(d), provided detailed nadir views of the crop canopy, facilitating the identification of individual plants and their phenological characteristics. To increase dataset variability and enhance the robustness and generalizability of the trained model under diverse natural conditions, image acquisition was performed at three distinct times of day: morning, midday, and late afternoon. In total, 153 raw in-flight images were collected. It is important to note that all images utilized in this study remained in their raw form, as no image mosaicking software was applied during data processing.
本研究在中国广东省湛江市徐闻县（约北纬 20°26′，东经 110°10′）的一处菠萝种植基地开展，如图 1(a)所示。徐闻作为中国重要的菠萝主产区，属热带季风湿润气候，具有高温、多雨、旱季日照充足的特点，这些气候条件有利于菠萝实现高产优质。实验周期为 2025 年 9 月 25 日至 29 日，此时菠萝处于早期结果阶段（图 1(b)），且环境光照条件存在差异。数据采集采用大疆 Phantom 4 RTK 无人机，搭载配备 1 英寸 FC6310 CMOS 传感器、24 毫米等效焦距 f/2.8 广角镜头的相机，可拍摄 5280×3956 像素分辨率的 RGB 图像（如图 1(c)所示）。值得注意的是，数据采集通过手动操控无人机完成，未使用预设飞行轨迹。 在整个图像采集过程中，无人机在地面以上 5 至 15 米的高度保持稳定悬停，机载相机始终以天底方向进行拍摄。如图 1(d)所示，所获取的图像提供了作物冠层的详细天底视图，有助于识别单株植物及其物候特征。为增加数据集多样性并提升训练模型在不同自然条件下的鲁棒性和泛化能力，图像采集分别在三个不同时段进行：早晨、正午和傍晚。共采集了 153 张原始飞行图像。 需要特别指出的是，本研究所使用的所有图像均保持原始未处理状态由于数据处理过程中未使用图像拼接软件。

2.2. Dataset production  2.2. 数据集制作

This research developed a pineapple image dataset to facilitate the training of a deep learning model. The initial dataset comprised 370 JPG images, each with a resolution of 5280 × 3956 pixels. Direct training on these high-resolution UAV imagery posed challenges due to GPU memory constraints. Furthermore, the small size and dense clustering of pineapples within individual images complicated accurate detection and localization. These factors led to the loss of essential visual features during network downsampling and introduced spatial ambiguities that impeded instance differentiation. To address these issues, an image cropping approach was employed to generate appropriately sized image patches while preserving the integrity of the target objects. The original images were cropped uniformly to dimensions of 1280 × 1280 pixels. As illustrated in Fig. 2, the following data preprocessing procedures were conducted:
本研究开发了一个菠萝图像数据集，以促进深度学习模型的训练。初始数据集包含 370 张 JPG 格式图像，每张图像分辨率为 5280×3956 像素。由于 GPU 内存限制，直接使用这些高分辨率无人机影像进行训练存在挑战。此外，单张图像中菠萝目标体积小且密集聚集，给精准检测与定位带来困难。这些因素导致网络下采样过程中关键视觉特征丢失，并引入空间模糊性，阻碍了实例区分。为解决上述问题，采用图像裁剪方法生成尺寸合适的图像块，同时保持目标对象的完整性。原始图像被统一裁剪为 1280×1280 像素尺寸。如图 2 所示，执行了以下数据预处理流程：
  • (1)
    The original images were cropped with a one-third overlap to ensure continuity. For regions near the image edges, mirror padding was applied to complete the image boundaries. Sub-images containing fewer than five pineapple instances were excluded, as they provided insufficient data for effective feature extraction. Additionally, to avoid excessive training on padded regions, any sub-image with padding exceeding one-quarter of its total area was discarded. Ultimately, each original image yielded 15 sub-images.
    原始图像以三分之一重叠率进行裁剪，以确保连续性。对于靠近图像边缘的区域，采用镜像填充法补全图像边界。包含少于五个菠萝实例的子图像被剔除，因其数据量不足以支持有效特征提取。此外，为避免对填充区域过度训练，任何填充面积超过总面积四分之一的子图像均被舍弃。最终，每张原始图像生成 15 张子图像。
  • (2)
    Pineapple instances were annotated using LabelMe software, which provided the coordinates of the minimum bounding rectangles saved in JSON format. LabelMe annotations specify bounding boxes via the coordinates of the top-left and bottom-right corners. However, the YOLO training framework requires annotations in terms of the bounding box center coordinates along with its width and height. Consequently, the LabelMe annotation files were converted into the YOLO format and saved as TXT files.
    使用 LabelMe 软件对菠萝实例进行标注，该软件以 JSON 格式保存最小外接矩形的坐标信息。LabelMe 标注通过左上角和右下角坐标定义边界框。然而，YOLO 训练框架要求标注信息包含边界框中心坐标及其宽度和高度。因此，将 LabelMe 标注文件转换为 YOLO 格式并保存为 TXT 文件。
In total, 2,075 images were annotated in this study. The dataset was subsequently partitioned into training, validation, and test subsets in an 8:1:1 ratio, comprising 1,659, 208, and 208 images, respectively.
本研究共标注了 2075 张图像。随后按照 8:1:1 的比例将数据集划分为训练集、验证集和测试集，分别包含 1659 张、208 张和 208 张图像。

2.3. YOLO-pineapple framework
2.3. YOLO-pineapple 框架

2.3.1. Overview of YOLO-pineapple
2.3.1. YOLO-pineapple 概述

This research utilizes the YOLOv8 model as the foundational baseline because it offers a superior balance between model complexity and processing capabilities for UAV-based deployment while serving as a widely benchmarked architecture with proven success in complex agricultural scenarios. The YOLOv8 is composed of three primary components: the backbone, neck, and head. The backbone network is dedicated to feature extraction and introduces the C2f module (CSP Bottleneck with two convolutions, fused). This module processes the input feature map through multiple parallel bottleneck blocks and integrates their outputs with a partitioned segment of the original input. Such a design facilitates a more robust gradient flow, mitigates information loss, and enhances the model’s capacity for feature extraction while maintaining computational efficiency. Within the neck network, the conventional PAN-FPN (Path Aggregation Network-Feature Pyramid Network) architecture is employed to achieve multi-scale feature fusion. This approach concatenates upsampled feature maps directly with those from the backbone, followed by a subsequent C2f module that consolidates and fuses features across different scales. This strategy reduces both parameter count and computational overhead, streamlines the feature fusion pathway, and thereby improves the network’s object recognition capabilities. In the head component, YOLOv8 adopts an anchor-free design alongside a decoupled head structure, which segregates classification and bounding box regression into two distinct branches. This separation facilitates more effective feature learning, diminishes inter-task interference, and reduces noise during gradient propagation, collectively enhancing model performance.
本研究以 YOLOv8 模型作为基础基线，因其在模型复杂度与处理能力之间实现了更优平衡，适用于无人机部署场景，同时作为广泛验证的架构，在复杂农业场景中已取得显著成效。YOLOv8 由三个核心组件构成：主干网络、颈部网络和检测头。主干网络专用于特征提取，引入了 C2f 模块（融合双卷积的跨阶段局部瓶颈结构）。该模块通过多个并行瓶颈块处理输入特征图，并将其输出与原始输入的分割部分进行整合。这种设计有助于增强梯度流动，减少信息损失，在保持计算效率的同时提升模型的特征提取能力。在颈部网络中，采用传统的 PAN-FPN（路径聚合网络-特征金字塔网络）架构实现多尺度特征融合。 该方法将上采样后的特征图直接与主干网络的特征图进行拼接，随后通过 C2f 模块整合并融合不同尺度的特征。这一策略不仅降低了参数量和计算开销，还简化了特征融合路径，从而提升了网络的目标识别能力。在检测头部分，YOLOv8 采用无锚框设计配合解耦头结构，将分类任务与边界框回归任务分离为两个独立分支。这种分离机制有助于更高效的特征学习，减少任务间的相互干扰，并降低梯度传播过程中的噪声，共同提升了模型性能。
To optimize the detection of pineapples in UAV imagery acquired under field conditions, modifications were made to the YOLOv8 model to strengthen its ability to extract pineapple-specific features amidst complex backgrounds. The overall architecture of the enhanced model is illustrated in Fig. 3.
为优化田间条件下无人机影像中菠萝的检测效果，对 YOLOv8 模型进行了改进，以增强其在复杂背景中提取菠萝特异性特征的能力。改进后模型的整体架构如图 3 所示。
The baseline YOLOv8 architecture utilizes three detection heads designed to identify large, medium, and small objects. Given that pineapples in UAV imagery typically appear as small objects, the original YOLOv8 configuration yields suboptimal performance for this task. To address this limitation, we introduce the DITAH to enhance the model’s performance. The DITAH framework initially extracts interactive features pertinent to classification and localization through shared convolutional layers. Following this, a task decomposition module independently derives features specific to each task. These independent features are then integrated with the previously obtained interactive features to produce a combined representation. A comprehensive description of the DITAH is provided in Section 2.3.2.
基线 YOLOv8 架构采用三个检测头，分别用于识别大、中、小目标。由于无人机影像中的菠萝通常呈现为小目标，原始 YOLOv8 配置在此任务中表现欠佳。为解决这一局限，我们引入 DITAH 以增强模型性能。DITAH 框架首先通过共享卷积层提取与分类和定位相关的交互特征，随后任务分解模块独立推导各任务专属特征，最后将这些独立特征与先前获取的交互特征融合，形成组合表征。第 2.3.2 节将对 DITAH 进行详细阐述。
Moreover, to tackle the complexities associated with pineapple detection in cluttered and challenging environments, we propose a novel GMSC convolutional module as a replacement for the second CBS convolutional block within the original BottleNeck structure. The GMSC facilitates multi-scale feature extraction via grouped convolutions and incorporates the CBAM attention mechanism. This design enables the model to prioritize salient pineapple features while suppressing redundant information, thereby mitigating the impact of irrelevant background elements. Further elaboration on the GMSC is available in Section 2.3.3.
此外，为应对杂乱复杂环境下菠萝检测的挑战，我们提出了一种新型 GMSC 卷积模块，用于替代原始 BottleNeck 结构中的第二个 CBS 卷积块。GMSC 通过分组卷积实现多尺度特征提取，并集成了 CBAM 注意力机制。该设计使模型能够优先关注显著的菠萝特征，同时抑制冗余信息，从而减轻无关背景元素的影响。关于 GMSC 的详细阐述见第 2.3.3 节。
In addition, we enhance the original CIoU loss function employed by the YOLOv8 network by substituting it with the Focaler-IoU loss. This modification allows the model to place greater emphasis on small pineapple objects during training. Detailed information regarding this improvement is discussed in Section 2.3.4.
同时，我们通过将 YOLOv8 网络使用的原始 CIoU 损失函数替换为 Focaler-IoU 损失函数，对其进行了改进。这一修改使模型在训练过程中能够更加关注小尺寸菠萝目标。相关改进的详细信息在第 2.3.4 节中讨论。

2.3.2. Dynamic interactive task alignment head (DITAH)
2.3.2. 动态交互式任务对齐头（DITAH）

YOLOv8 employs a decoupled head architecture, wherein distinct prediction branches are utilized to independently address localization and classification tasks. This design aims to reduce the mutual interference between these two tasks. However, as highlighted by Feng et al., (2021) in their work on TOOD, localization and classification fundamentally differ in their optimization objectives and learning paradigms. As a result, the feature representations that are optimal for localization may not be equally effective for classification, and vice versa. Consequently, separate branches for these predictions may introduce spatial inconsistencies between the feature spaces associated with each task, thereby giving rise to the task misalignment problem.
YOLOv8 采用解耦头架构，通过独立的预测分支分别处理定位和分类任务，旨在减少这两项任务之间的相互干扰。然而，正如 Feng 等人（2021）在 TOOD 研究中指出的，定位和分类在优化目标和学习范式上存在本质差异。因此，对定位最优的特征表示可能对分类并非同样有效，反之亦然。这种分离的预测分支会导致各任务特征空间出现空间不一致性，从而引发任务错位问题。
To address the aforementioned challenge, this study initially introduces the Dynamic Interactive Task Alignment Head (DITAH). The architectural schematic is presented in Fig. 4. Two convolutional blocks employing Group Normalization (GroupNorm) were designed to process the input feature map (CGS), given that GroupNorm has been empirically shown to enhance model performance. Drawing inspiration from the skip connections utilized in ResNet, the refined output features from these convolutional blocks are concatenated with the original input features along the channel dimension. This procedure effectively integrates multi-level feature representations, thereby producing more robust interactive features for subsequent localization and classification tasks. The mathematical formulation of this operation is provided as follows:
为解决上述挑战，本研究首先引入了动态交互任务对齐头（DITAH），其架构示意图如图 4 所示。鉴于组归一化（GroupNorm）已被实验证明能提升模型性能，我们设计了两个采用组归一化的卷积模块来处理输入特征图（CGS）。受 ResNet 中跳跃连接思想的启发，这两个卷积模块输出的精炼特征将沿通道维度与原始输入特征进行拼接。该操作有效融合了多层级特征表征，从而为后续的定位与分类任务生成更具鲁棒性的交互特征。该操作的数学表达式如下：(1)X1=δ1(Conv1(X))(2)X2=δ1(Conv2(X1))(3)Xinter=X2+X1=δ1(Conv2(X1))+δ1(Conv1(X))
where X represents the feature supplied by the Neck layer, Conv denotes the convolutional block with GroupNorm normalization, δ1 is the SiLU activation function, and Xinter signifies the interactive features obtained via concatenation after the convolutional blocks.
其中， X 表示由 Neck 层提供的特征， Conv 表示带有 GroupNorm 归一化的卷积模块， δ1 为 SiLU 激活函数， Xinter 表示经卷积模块后通过拼接操作获得的交互特征。
Secondly, we introduced the TaskDecomposition module to learn task-specific features for the localization and classification branches independently. Sharing the same interactive features between these two branches can lead to conflicts at the feature level, as their learning objectives differ. The TaskDecomposition module firstly applies global average pooling to the input joint feature map Xinter to compress the global spatial information into a channel descriptor. This descriptor is then passed through two convolutional branches, each designed to learn dynamic channel-wise weights for the localization and classification tasks, respectively. Finally, the generated weights wtask are applied to the original input feature map through channel-wise multiplication and obtain the task-specific features Xtask. The calculation is formulated as follows:
其次，我们引入了任务分解模块，用于独立学习定位分支和分类分支的任务特定特征。由于这两个分支的学习目标不同，共享相同的交互特征会导致特征层面的冲突。任务分解模块首先对输入的联合特征图 Xinter 进行全局平均池化，将全局空间信息压缩为通道描述符。该描述符随后被输入两个卷积分支，分别用于学习定位任务和分类任务的动态通道权重。最后，通过通道级乘法将生成的权重 wtask 应用于原始输入特征图，获得任务特定特征 Xtask 。其计算公式如下：(4)wtask=σ(conv2(δ2(conv1(AvgPool(Xinter)))))(5)Xtask=wtask×Xinter
where AvgPool represents the average pooling operation, conv denotes convolutional operations, δ2 is the ReLU activation function, and σ is the sigmoid activation function.
其中 AvgPool 表示平均池化操作， conv 表示卷积操作， δ2 是 ReLU 激活函数， σ 是 Sigmoid 激活函数。
Following the extraction of independent localization and classification features via the TaskDecomposition module, these features are subsequently integrated with the original feature set, and feature alignment is performed for each respective branch. This procedure ensures that the resulting features encapsulate interactive information while simultaneously mitigating inter-task conflicts. Specifically, for the localization branch, a Regression Alignment Generator module was developed, which utilizes the original joint features as input to dynamically predict the offset and mask parameters necessary for Deformable Convolution (DCNv2). The DCNv2 operator then applies deformable convolution to the independent localization features, guided by these parameters derived from the joint features. This approach facilitates the alignment of the receptive field of the localization features with the object region, thereby enhancing spatial precision.
通过任务分解模块提取独立的定位和分类特征后，这些特征随后与原始特征集进行融合，并针对各分支分别执行特征对齐操作。该流程确保最终特征既能包含交互信息，又能同时缓解任务间冲突。具体而言，针对定位分支开发了回归对齐生成器模块，该模块以原始联合特征为输入，动态预测可变形卷积（DCNv2）所需的偏移量和掩膜参数。随后 DCNv2 算子根据联合特征生成的参数，对独立定位特征执行可变形卷积操作。这种方法有助于将定位特征的感受野与目标区域对齐，从而提升空间精度。
In the classification branch, a Classification Alignment Weight Generator module was designed, also taking the original joint features as input. Employing a spatial attention mechanism, this module generates a two-dimensional weight map that highlights informative regions. This weight map is applied to the independent classification features through element-wise multiplication, which amplifies salient features of target regions while suppressing background noise, thus effectively improving classification accuracy.
在分类分支中，设计了一个分类对齐权重生成器模块，同样以原始联合特征作为输入。该模块采用空间注意力机制，生成一个能够突出信息丰富区域的二维权重图。通过逐元素乘法将该权重图应用于独立的分类特征，既能增强目标区域的显著特征，又能抑制背景噪声，从而有效提升分类精度。
While influenced by the general principles of task alignment in one-stage detectors, DITAH fundamentally diverges from prior models like TOOD by utilizing a dynamic interaction mechanism that keeps interactive information through Group Normalization while mitigating inter-task conflicts via independent TaskDecomposition modules. In summary, the DITAH architecture effectively addresses feature conflicts and task misalignment between localization and classification tasks. Initially, it extracts joint interactive features using Group Normalization and skip connections. Subsequently, the TaskDecomposition module independently learns task-specific features, allowing each branch to develop more specialized and distinct feature representations. By leveraging interactive information while maintaining task separation, DITAH significantly enhances the model’s ability to detect and localize pineapple objects within complex backgrounds.
尽管受到单阶段检测器中任务对齐通用原则的影响，DITAH 通过采用动态交互机制，在利用组归一化保持交互信息的同时，借助独立的任务分解模块缓解任务间冲突，从而从根本上区别于 TOOD 等先前模型。总之，DITAH 架构有效解决了定位与分类任务之间的特征冲突和任务错位问题。首先，它通过组归一化和跳跃连接提取联合交互特征；随后，任务分解模块独立学习任务特定特征，使每个分支能够形成更专业、更具区分性的特征表示。通过利用交互信息的同时保持任务分离，DITAH 显著提升了模型在复杂背景下检测和定位菠萝目标的能力。

2.3.3. Grouped multi-scale convolution (GMSC)
2.3.3. 分组多尺度卷积（GMSC）

Conventional convolutional operations generally require considerable computational resources to effectively process complex features. Moreover, feature redundancy can lead to inefficiencies, especially in the context of pineapple detection from UAV imagery. To enhance the model's performance, the GMSC architecture was introduced, as depicted in Fig. 5. This proposed module facilitates the reduction of redundant computations while enabling efficient extraction of multi-scale features.
传统的卷积操作通常需要大量的计算资源才能有效处理复杂特征。此外，特征冗余可能导致效率低下，尤其是在无人机影像中检测菠萝的背景下。为了提升模型性能，引入了 GMSC 架构，如图 5 所示。该模块有助于减少冗余计算，同时实现多尺度特征的高效提取。
The GMSC architecture strategically partitions the input feature channels into three distinct groups. Half of these channels are transmitted directly, a design choice that mitigates redundant computations while preserving essential information. The remaining channels are divided into two subsets, which undergo 3 × 3 and 5 × 5 convolution operations, respectively. The 3 × 3 convolution effectively captures local features, whereas the 5 × 5 convolution, with its larger receptive field, facilitates the extraction of multi-scale information. This is particularly important for detecting pineapples of varying sizes under natural field condition.
GMSC 架构将输入特征通道策略性地划分为三个不同的组。其中一半通道直接传输，这种设计选择在保留关键信息的同时减少了冗余计算。剩余通道被分为两个子集，分别进行 3×3 和 5×5 卷积运算。3×3 卷积能有效捕捉局部特征，而 5×5 卷积凭借更大的感受野，有助于提取多尺度信息。这对于在自然田间条件下检测不同大小的菠萝尤为重要。
Afterwards, the GMSC module concatenates these feature channels to form a feature map containing multi-scale information. Subsequently, this feature map is fed into a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM), which selectively enhances the weights of critical features and concentrates its attention on the most relevant regions. Next, the 1 × 1 convolution was applied to the CBAM-refined features to achieve inter-channel information fusion and interaction, effectively integrating the multi-scale features. Finally, an additional CBAM module is added to refine the fused feature map further. This secondary refinement enhances the network’s ability to focus more precisely on critical information in the final output. Subsequently, the GMSC concatenates these processed feature channels to generate a composite feature map enriched with multi-scale information. This feature map is then input into a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM), which selectively amplifies the weights of salient features and directs attention toward the most pertinent regions. Following this, a 1 × 1 convolution is applied to the CBAM-refined features to enable inter-channel information fusion and interaction, thereby effectively integrating the multi-scale features. To further enhance the representation, an additional CBAM module is employed to refine the fused feature map, improving the network’s capacity to concentrate more precisely on critical information in the final output.
随后，GMSC 模块将这些特征通道拼接，形成包含多尺度信息的特征图。接着，该特征图被输入卷积块注意力模块（CBAM），该模块选择性地增强关键特征的权重，并将注意力集中于最相关的区域。然后，对经 CBAM 优化的特征应用 1×1 卷积，实现通道间的信息融合与交互，有效整合多尺度特征。最后，额外添加一个 CBAM 模块，进一步优化融合后的特征图。这种二次优化增强了网络在最终输出中更精准聚焦关键信息的能力。随后，GMSC 将处理后的特征通道拼接，生成富含多尺度信息的复合特征图。该特征图随后被输入卷积块注意力模块（CBAM），该模块选择性地放大显著特征的权重，并将注意力导向最相关的区域。 随后，对经 CBAM 优化的特征应用 1×1 卷积，实现通道间信息融合与交互，从而有效整合多尺度特征。为进一步增强表征能力，采用额外的 CBAM 模块对融合后的特征图进行优化，提升网络在最终输出中更精准聚焦关键信息的能力。
Through multi-level feature processing, the GMSC not only enhances the model’s focus on key pineapple features amidst complex backgrounds but also reduces computational complexity, thereby optimizing both accuracy and efficiency.
通过多层次特征处理，GMSC 不仅增强了模型在复杂背景下对菠萝关键特征的关注度，还降低了计算复杂度，从而同时优化了准确性和效率。

2.3.4. Spatial and channel synergistic attention (SCSA)
2.3.4. 空间与通道协同注意力机制（SCSA）

While conventional attention mechanisms contribute to improved feature learning, they often fail to adequately capture the semantic interactions between spatial and channel dimensions. To enhance the precision of pineapple detection, we incorporated the SCSA module (Si et al., 2025) subsequent to the SPPF module. As depicted in Fig. 6, SCSA module comprises two consecutively linked components: the Shared Multi-Semantic Spatial Attention (SMSA) module and the Progressive Channel-wise Self-Attention (PCSA) module.
尽管传统的注意力机制有助于改进特征学习，但往往无法充分捕捉空间维度和通道维度之间的语义交互。为提高菠萝检测的精度，我们在 SPPF 模块之后引入了 SCSA 模块（Si 等人，2025）。如图 6 所示，SCSA 模块由两个依次连接的组件构成：共享多语义空间注意力（SMSA）模块和渐进式通道自注意力（PCSA）模块。
The SMSA module is designed to enhance feature representation within the spatial domain. It achieves this by partitioning the input feature map into multiple groups along the channel dimension and applying one-dimensional convolutional kernels of varying sizes (e.g., 3, 5, 7, 9) to each group. This methodology facilitates the extraction of multi-semantic and multi-scale spatial information, resulting in the generation of a spatial attention map that assigns weights to emphasize the most salient regions. Following this, the PCSA module takes the feature map produced by the SMSA and employs a self-attention mechanism to evaluate channel-wise correlations, thereby identifying the most informative combinations of channels. Concurrently, the PCSA leverages the spatial information derived from the SMSA to mitigate semantic inconsistencies introduced by the multi-scale operations, promoting effective feature fusion.
SMSA 模块旨在增强空间域内的特征表示能力。其实现方式是将输入特征图沿通道维度划分为多个组，并对每个组应用不同尺寸（如 3、5、7、9）的一维卷积核。该方法有助于提取多语义、多尺度的空间信息，从而生成空间注意力图，通过分配权重来突出最显著的区域。随后，PCSA 模块接收 SMSA 生成的特征图，并采用自注意力机制评估通道间的相关性，进而识别出信息量最丰富的通道组合。同时，PCSA 利用 SMSA 提取的空间信息，以缓解多尺度操作引入的语义不一致问题，促进有效的特征融合。

2.3.5. Focaler-SIoU loss function
2.3.5. Focaler-SIoU 损失函数

The precision of object localization in detection tasks is significantly affected by the choice of bounding box regression loss function. Nevertheless, current loss functions often overlook the imbalance between hard and easy samples. Typically, easy samples correspond to objects of standard scale, while hard samples are generally associated with small-sized objects. Zhang and Zhang, (2024) demonstrated that detection performance can be enhanced by adapting the focus of bounding box regression according to the sample types involved in the task. To this end, they introduced the Focaler-IoU loss function, which aims to improve detector performance by applying a linear interval mapping approach to reformulate the IoU loss. The corresponding formula is presented as follows:
在目标检测任务中，边界框回归损失函数的选择会显著影响目标定位的精度。然而，现有损失函数往往忽略了难易样本之间的不平衡问题。通常，简单样本对应标准尺度的目标，而困难样本则多与小尺寸目标相关。Zhang 和 Zhang（2024）的研究表明，通过根据任务中涉及的样本类型调整边界框回归的焦点，可以提升检测性能。为此，他们引入了 Focaler-IoU 损失函数，该函数通过线性区间映射方法重构 IoU 损失，旨在改善检测器性能。其对应公式如下：(6)IoUfocaler=0IoU<dIoU-du-dd<IoU<u1IoU>u
where IoUfocaler is the reconstructed Focaler-IoU, and IoU denotes the initial calculated IoU value, and d,u∈0,1. The Focaler-IoU model enables the selective prioritization of specific regression objects through the adjustment of parameters d and u.
其中 IoUfocaler 为重构后的 Focaler-IoU，IoU 表示初始计算的 IoU 值，且 d,u∈0,1 。Focaler-IoU 模型通过调整参数 d 和 u ，能够有选择性地优先处理特定回归对象。
To enhance both the convergence rate and geometric accuracy of bounding box regression, Zhang et al., (2020) proposed the Complete Intersection over Union (CIoU) loss function, which integrates constraints related to aspect ratio and center point distance in a comprehensive manner. Building upon this, Zhora Gevorgyan, (2025) introduced the SIoU loss by incorporating an angular cost term aimed at reducing the degrees of freedom in regression, thereby facilitating faster convergence and improved localization precision. Motivated by the geometric effectiveness of SIoU and the sample balancing properties of the Focaler mechanism, the present study employs the Focaler_SIoU loss function. The corresponding formulation is presented below:
为提升边界框回归的收敛速度与几何精度，Zhang 等人（2020）提出了完全交并比（CIoU）损失函数，该函数以综合方式整合了长宽比与中心点距离的约束条件。在此基础上，Zhora Gevorgyan（2025）通过引入角度代价项提出了 SIoU 损失函数，旨在降低回归的自由度，从而促进更快的收敛与更优的定位精度。基于 SIoU 的几何有效性及 Focaler 机制的样本平衡特性，本研究采用 Focaler_SIoU 损失函数，其对应公式如下所示：(7)LFocaler-SIoU=LSIoU+IoU-IoUFocaler(8)LSIoU=1-IoU+Δ+Ω2.
where Δ denotes the distance cost function, and Ω represents the shape cost function. In this study, the best performance of the training model is achieved when α=0 and u=0.35 in the Focaler-SIoU.
其中 Δ 表示距离代价函数， Ω 代表形状代价函数。本研究中，当 Focaler-SIoU 中的 α=0 和 u=0.35 取特定值时，训练模型达到了最佳性能。

2.4. Experiment and evaluation
2.4. 实验与评估

2.4.1. Experimental settings
2.4.1. 实验设置

In this research, the YOLO-Pineapple model was developed utilizing the PyTorch 2.2.2 framework. Experimental procedures were conducted on an Ubuntu 24.01 operating system, supported by an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090D GPU with 24 GB of memory and an AMD Ryzen 9 7900X CPU accompanied by 64 GB of RAM. All models underwent training using a curated pineapple image dataset.
本研究基于 PyTorch 2.2.2 框架开发了 YOLO-Pineapple 模型。实验在 Ubuntu 24.01 操作系统上进行，配备 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090D GPU（24 GB 显存）和 AMD Ryzen 9 7900X CPU（64 GB 内存）。所有模型均使用精选菠萝图像数据集进行训练。
Input images were resized to a fixed dimension prior to being introduced to the model. The training parameters were established as follows: a batch size of 32, an initial learning rate of 0.01, and a total of 300 training epochs. Optimization was performed using the Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) algorithm, configured with a momentum coefficient of 0.937 and a weight decay factor of 0.0005.
输入图像在输入模型前被调整为固定尺寸。训练参数设置如下：批处理大小为 32，初始学习率为 0.01，总训练轮次为 300。采用随机梯度下降（SGD）算法进行优化，配置动量系数为 0.937，权重衰减因子为 0.0005。

2.4.2. Evaluation metrics
2.4.2. 评估指标

To evaluate the efficacy of the proposed pineapple detection model, standard performance metrics including Precision, Recall, F1 score, mean Average Precision at IoU threshold 0.5 (mAP@0.5), mean Average Precision averaged over IoU thresholds from 0.5 to 0.95 (mAP@0.5:0.95), as well as the number of model parameters and overall model size, are employed. Within the domain of object detection, prediction outcomes are typically classified into four categories based on the agreement between predicted labels and ground truth annotations. True Positives (TP) and True Negatives (TN) correspond to correctly identified positive and negative instances, respectively. In contrast, errors in prediction are categorized as False Positives (FP), where negative samples are erroneously classified as positive, and False Negatives (FN), which refer to positive samples that the model fails to detect. Furthermore, detection performance is notably influenced by the selection of the Intersection over Union (IoU) threshold, a critical hyperparameter. A higher IoU threshold enforces stricter localization accuracy by requiring closer overlap between predicted bounding boxes and ground truth, but this often results in an elevated false negative rate, thereby increasing the likelihood of missed pineapple detections. Conversely, a lower IoU threshold may enhance detection sensitivity but at the expense of reduced prediction reliability.
为评估所提出的菠萝检测模型的有效性，采用了包括精确率、召回率、F1 分数、IoU 阈值为 0.5 时的平均精度均值（mAP@0.5）、IoU 阈值从 0.5 到 0.95 的平均精度均值（mAP@0.5:0.95），以及模型参数量和整体模型大小在内的标准性能指标。在目标检测领域，预测结果通常根据预测标签与真实标注的一致性分为四类。真正例（TP）和真负例（TN）分别对应正确识别的正样本和负样本。相反，预测错误则分为假正例（FP），即负样本被错误分类为正样本，以及假负例（FN），即模型未能检测到的正样本。此外，检测性能显著受到交并比（IoU）阈值这一关键超参数选择的影响。 较高的 IoU 阈值通过要求预测边界框与真实框之间更紧密的重叠来强制执行更严格的定位精度，但这通常会导致假阴性率升高，从而增加菠萝漏检的可能性。相反，较低的 IoU 阈值可能提高检测灵敏度，但会降低预测的可靠性。
The mathematical definitions of these evaluation metrics are as follows: Precision quantifies the ratio of correctly identified pineapple instances to the total number of instances predicted as pineapples by the model.
这些评估指标的数学定义如下：精确率衡量的是模型正确识别的菠萝实例数量与模型预测为菠萝的实例总数之间的比率。(9)precision=TPTP+FP×100%
Recall refers to the ratio of correctly predicted pineapples to the total number of actual pineapples (ground truth) present in the dataset.
召回率指的是正确预测的菠萝数量与数据集中实际存在的菠萝总数（真实标注）之间的比率。(10)recall=TPTP+FN×100%
To consider the trade-off between Precision and Recall, the F1 score is commonly used to evaluate the model's overall effectiveness.
为了权衡精确率与召回率，通常采用 F1 分数来评估模型的整体效能。(11)F1=2×precision×recllprecision+recall
Average Precision (AP) represents the area beneath the Precision-Recall curve and serves as a measure of a model's capability to accurately identify instances of a single class. Mean Average Precision (mAP) is derived by calculating the mean of AP values across all detected categories. Standard evaluation protocols often employ mAP@0.5, which evaluates performance at a fixed Intersection over Union (IoU) threshold of 0.5. In contrast, mAP@0.5:0.95 offers a more comprehensive assessment by averaging AP scores over multiple IoU thresholds incremented from 0.5 to 0.95. The corresponding formula is presented below:
平均精度（AP）表示精确率-召回率曲线下的面积，用于衡量模型准确识别单一类别实例的能力。平均精度均值（mAP）通过计算所有检测类别 AP 值的平均值得到。标准评估协议通常采用 mAP@0.5，即在固定交并比（IoU）阈值为 0.5 时评估性能。相比之下，mAP@0.5:0.95 通过计算从 0.5 到 0.95 多个 IoU 阈值下 AP 分数的平均值，提供更全面的评估。相应公式如下所示：(12)AP=∫01P(R)d(R)(13)mAP=1N∑i=1NAPi
where N represents the total number of instances of a certain category.
其中 N 表示某类别的实例总数。
To assess the scale and computational complexity of the proposed model, we employed three metrics: the total count of learnable parameters, indicative of the architectural depth; the floating-point operations per second (FLOPs), measuring the computational expense; and the model size in megabytes (MB), denoting the storage requirements.
为评估所提模型的规模与计算复杂度，我们采用三项指标：可学习参数总数（反映架构深度）、每秒浮点运算次数（FLOPs，衡量计算开销）以及模型大小（以兆字节 MB 为单位，表示存储需求）。(14)params=(I×H×W+1)×O
where I denotes the number of input channels, H×W is the size of the kernel, O is the number of output channels.
其中 I 表示输入通道数， H×W 为卷积核尺寸， O 表示输出通道数。

3. Results  3. 结果

3.1. Internal module optimization and selection
3.1. 内部模块优化与选择

3.1.1. Comparison of different attention mechanisms for the GMSC module
3.1.1. GMSC 模块不同注意力机制对比

To identify the most effective attention mechanism for the proposed GMSC, a comparative analysis was performed between the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) and several alternative attention mechanisms, namely Coordinate Attention (CA), Bottleneck Attention Module (BAM), Efficient Multi-Scale Attention (EMA), and Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE). The quantitative evaluation outcomes are presented in Table 1.
为确定所提出的 GMSC 模块最有效的注意力机制，在卷积块注意力模块（CBAM）与坐标注意力（CA）、瓶颈注意力模块（BAM）、高效多尺度注意力（EMA）及压缩激励模块（SE）等替代注意力机制之间进行了对比分析。定量评估结果如表 1 所示。

表 1. GMSC 中不同注意力机制的对比

ModelPrecision  精确度Recall  召回率mAP@0.5mAP@0.5:0.95F1Size(MB)  大小（MB）Params(M)  参数（百万）FLOPs(G)  FLOPs（G）

The findings indicate that the incorporation of the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) yields superior performance compared with other attention mechanisms. Specifically, the model incorporating CBAM achieved a Precision of 92.7%, a Recall of 89.1%, and a mean Average Precision at IoU threshold 0.5 (mAP@0.5) of 93.8%, surpassing the performance of the next best alternatives, namely Coordinate Attention (CA) and Bottleneck Attention Module (BAM). Regarding the F1 score, CBAM achieved the highest value of 90.9%, exceeding the scores of the Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) and CA mechanisms by 0.7% and 0.6%, respectively. While the SE mechanism primarily addresses channel dependencies and CA emphasizes positional information, neither sufficiently captures the multi-dimensional features essential for complex field environments. In contrast, CBAM sequentially applies attention along both spatial and channel dimensions, enabling the model to adaptively refine feature representations. This dual-attention strategy effectively suppresses background noise, such as dense foliage, while enhancing the semantic representation of small pineapples. Although the integration of CBAM introduces a marginal increase in parameter count (0.05 million more than CA), this slight computational overhead is justified by the notable improvements in detection accuracy and robustness. Therefore, CBAM was selected as it offers an optimal balance between model complexity and performance.
研究结果表明，相较于其他注意力机制，引入卷积块注意力模块（CBAM）能带来更优性能。具体而言，融合 CBAM 的模型实现了 92.7%的精确率、89.1%的召回率，以及 IoU 阈值为 0.5 时的平均精度均值（mAP@0.5）达 93.8%，显著优于次优方案——坐标注意力（CA）和瓶颈注意力模块（BAM）。在 F1 分数方面，CBAM 以 90.9%的最高值领先，分别超过挤压激励（SE）和 CA 机制 0.7%和 0.6%。虽然 SE 机制主要处理通道依赖性，CA 机制侧重位置信息，但两者均未能充分捕捉复杂田间环境所需的多维特征。相比之下，CBAM 沿空间和通道维度依次应用注意力机制，使模型能够自适应地优化特征表示。这种双注意力策略有效抑制了密集叶片等背景噪声，同时增强了小尺寸菠萝的语义表征能力。 尽管 CBAM 的集成导致参数量略有增加（比 CA 多 0.05 百万），但这种轻微的计算开销被检测精度和鲁棒性的显著提升所弥补。因此，选择 CBAM 作为最优方案，在模型复杂度与性能之间实现了理想平衡。

3.1.2. Comparison result of loss functions
3.1.2. 损失函数对比结果

To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed bounding box regression strategy, the performance of the baseline CIoU loss against various Focaler-based variants was compared, including Focaler-CIoU and the proposed Focaler_SIoU. The comparative results are detailed in Table 2, and the training loss convergence curve is illustrated in Fig. 7.
为评估所提出的边界框回归策略的有效性，将基线 CIoU 损失与多种基于 Focaler 的变体（包括 Focaler-CIoU 和本文提出的 Focaler_SIoU）进行了性能对比。对比结果详见表 2，训练损失收敛曲线如图 7 所示。

Table 2. Comparison of different IoU-based loss functions.
表 2. 不同基于 IoU 的损失函数对比

ModelPrecision  精确率Recall  召回率mAP@0.5mAP@0.5:0.95F1
CIoU93.8%88.5%94.1%63.1%91.1%
Focaler_CIoU94.3%88.4%94.2%62.5%91.3%
Focaler_SIoU94.6%88.9%94.4%62.9%91.7%
The baseline model employing the Complete Intersection over Union (CIoU) loss function attained a precision of 93.8% and a mean Average Precision at an Intersection over Union threshold of 0.5 (mAP@0.5) of 94.1%. The incorporation of the Focaler mechanism with CIoU (denoted as Focaler-CIoU) resulted in an increase in precision to 94.3% and an F1 score of 91.3%. This improvement underscores the efficacy of the Focaler approach in reconstructing the IoU loss through linear interval mapping, which enhances the weighting of challenging samples, such as occluded or small objects, during the optimization process. Nevertheless, this rebalancing led to a marginal reduction in mAP@0.5:0.95, decreasing from 63.1% to 62.5%, suggesting a trade-off whereby gains in Recall for difficult samples were offset by a decline in localization accuracy for high-quality predictions. To mitigate this limitation, the proposed Focaler_SIoU loss function combines the sample rebalancing capability of Focaler with the geometric constraints of SIoU. By restricting the degrees of freedom in regression, this approach enables the model to align bounding box orientation prior to optimizing spatial distance, thereby preventing oscillatory convergence behavior. As a result, the Focaler_SIoU loss function achieved an optimal balance across evaluation metrics, yielding a precision of 94.6%, an mAP@0.5 of 94.4%, and an mAP@0.5:0.95 of 62.9%.
采用完整交并比（CIoU）损失函数的基线模型实现了 93.8%的精确率和 94.1%的平均精度均值（IoU 阈值为 0.5 时的 mAP@0.5）。将 Focaler 机制与 CIoU 结合（记为 Focaler-CIoU）后，精确率提升至 94.3%，F1 分数达到 91.3%。这一改进凸显了 Focaler 方法通过线性区间映射重构 IoU 损失的有效性——该方法在优化过程中增强了对遮挡或小目标等困难样本的权重分配。然而，这种重平衡导致 mAP@0.5:0.95 从 63.1%小幅下降至 62.5%，表明存在权衡关系：困难样本召回率的提升被高质量预测定位精度的下降所抵消。为缓解这一局限，本文提出的 Focaler_SIoU 损失函数将 Focaler 的样本重平衡能力与 SIoU 的几何约束相结合。 通过限制回归中的自由度，该方法使模型在优化空间距离之前对齐边界框方向，从而防止振荡收敛行为。 因此，Focaler_SIoU 损失函数在各项评估指标之间实现了最佳平衡精确率达到 94.6%，mAP@0.5 为 94.4%，mAP@0.5:0.95 为 62.9%。
As depicted in Fig. 7, the box loss curves reveal convergence patterns across the three models under investigation. The baseline YOLOv8 model displays oscillatory behavior in the later phases of training, indicating instability in bounding box regression. Conversely, the model incorporating Focaler_SIoU demonstrates a more pronounced initial decline and achieves a lower terminal loss value relative to both the baseline and alternative models. These findings substantiate that the integration of the geometric constraints inherent in SIoU effectively mitigates the oscillatory convergence typically induced by angle discrepancies, thereby enabling the model to attain a reduced final loss.
如图 7 所示，框损失曲线揭示了所研究的三种模型的收敛模式。基线 YOLOv8 模型在训练后期表现出振荡行为，表明边界框回归存在不稳定性。相比之下，引入 Focaler_SIoU 的模型在初始阶段下降更为显著，且最终损失值低于基线模型及其他对比模型。这些发现证实，融合 SIoU 固有的几何约束能有效缓解角度差异引起的振荡收敛现象，从而使模型获得更低的最终损失值。

3.1.3. Sensitivity analysis of the Focaler_SIoU loss
3.1.3. Focaler_SIoU 损失函数的敏感性分析

To further evaluate the robustness of the Focaler_SIoU loss function, a sensitivity analysis on the hyperparameter μ was conducted, which controls the linear interval mapping of the IoU loss. Based on the experimental settings, the parameter α was fixed at 0 to prioritize the learning of hard samples. The results of varying μ are presented in Table 3 and illustrated in Fig. 8.
为进一步评估 Focaler_SIoU 损失函数的鲁棒性，对其超参数 μ 进行了敏感性分析，该参数控制 IoU 损失的线性区间映射。基于实验设置，将参数 α 固定为 0，以优先学习困难样本。 μ 的变化结果如表 3 所示，并在图 8 中进行了展示。

The analysis reveals that the mAP@0.5 and F1-score initially increase as μ approaches 0.35 and subsequently decline. This trend suggests that μ=0.35 provides the most effective focusing range for the specific size distribution of pineapples in this UAV imagery dataset. When μ is too low, the model may over-fit to extremely difficult outliers; conversely, a high μ value diminishes the sample rebalancing advantage of the Focaler mechanism.
分析表明，mAP@0.5 和 F1 分数随 μ 趋近 0.35 而先升后降。这一趋势表明， μ=0.35 为该无人机影像数据集中菠萝的特定尺寸分布提供了最有效的聚焦范围。当 μ 过低时，模型可能对极端困难异常值过拟合；反之，过高的 μ 值会削弱 Focaler 机制的样本重平衡优势。

Further integration of the SCSA module maintained Recall at a comparable level while increasing Precision to 93.1% and mAP@0.5 to 94%. that DITAH and SCSA are instrumental in reducing model complexity, whereas GMSC and Focaler_SIoU contribute significantly to enhancing detection accuracy.

图 9 进一步展示了不同模型配置在 300 个训练周期中 mAP@0.5 和 F1 分数的训练轨迹。如图 9(a)和图 9(b)所示，基线 YOLOv8 模型表现出的性能指标最低。随着 DITAH、GMSC、SCSA 和 Focaler_SIoU 模块的逐步加入，性能曲线呈现出持续提升的趋势。这些发现表明，所提出的架构改进有效解决了模型复杂度与检测精度之间的权衡问题，从而在复杂田间环境中实现了更稳健、更可靠的菠萝检测系统。

As demonstrated in the accompanying table, the proposed model attained superior performance across nearly all accuracy metrics while maintaining a lightweight architecture. Notably, in comparison to YOLOv11, the proposed model exhibited enhanced pineapple detection capabilities, achieving a precision of 94% and an mAP@0.5 of 93.4%. More precisely, it improved Precision by 0.6%, Recall by 1.1%, and mAP@0.5 by 1.0%, reaching values of 94.6%, 88.9%, and 94.4%, respectively. 如附表所示，所提模型在保持轻量化架构的同时，几乎所有精度指标均取得了更优表现。值得注意的是，与 YOLOv11 相比，该模型在菠萝检测方面展现出更优性能，实现了 94%的精确率和 93.4%的 mAP@0.5。具体而言，其精确率提升 0.6%、召回率提升 1.1%、mAP@0.5 提升 1.0%，分别达到 94.6%、88.9%和 94.4%。此外，在更严格的评估指标 mAP@0.5:0.95 下，所提模型以 62.9%的得分超越 YOLOv11 的 62%，高出 0.9%，表明即使在更高的交并比阈值下仍具有稳健的定位精度。
Regarding model complexity, YOLOv9 demonstrated the lowest parameter count (1.97 million) and smallest model size (4.46 MB), attributable to its programmable gradient information (PGI) design. Nevertheless, the proposed model outperformed YOLOv9 in accuracy, with improvements of 1.4% in mAP@0.5 and 1.7% in mAP@0.5:0.95, accompanied by a marginal increase in model size (0.08 MB). Conversely, although YOLOv6 and YOLOv10 offer competitive inference speeds, both exhibited inferior detection accuracy. For example, the proposed model exceeded YOLOv10 by 2.6% in precision and 2.0% in mAP@0.5.
在模型复杂度方面，YOLOv9 凭借其可编程梯度信息（PGI）设计，展现出最低的参数数量（197 万）和最小的模型体积（4.46 MB）。尽管如此，所提出的模型在精度上仍优于 YOLOv9，mAP@0.5 和 mAP@0.5:0.95 分别提升了 1.4%和 1.7%，而模型体积仅略微增加（0.08 MB）。相比之下，虽然 YOLOv6 和 YOLOv10 具备有竞争力的推理速度，但两者的检测精度均较低。例如，所提模型在精确率上比 YOLOv10 高出 2.6%，在 mAP@0.5 上高出 2.0%。
In summary, the proposed model achieves an optimal balance between computational complexity and detection accuracy. Specifically, it delivers higher accuracy than YOLOv11 while preserving the lightweight model size characteristic of YOLOv9, rendering it well-suited for deployment on UAV platforms with constrained computational resources.
综上所述，所提出的模型在计算复杂度与检测精度之间实现了最优平衡。具体而言，它在保持 YOLOv9 轻量化模型体积特性的同时，提供了优于 YOLOv11 的检测精度，使其非常适合部署在计算资源受限的无人机平台上。
To intuitively illustrate the trade-off between detection accuracy and model size among the evaluated algorithms, Fig. 10 presents the number of parameters plotted against mAP@0.5:0.95 (Fig. 10(a)) and mAP@0.5 (Fig. 10(b)). Ideally, an optimal model is located in the upper-left quadrant, signifying high accuracy coupled with a minimal parameter count. As shown, the proposed model (indicated by a red star) occupies the most favorable position relative to all compared models. Although YOLOv9 (represented by a light green triangle) is situated slightly further to the left, its lower vertical placement reflects a considerable decrease in localization accuracy despite a modest reduction in model size. Conversely, the proposed model outperforms YOLOv11 (denoted by a pink diamond) along the accuracy axis while maintaining a similarly low parameter count. These graphical findings further substantiate the superiority of the YOLO-Pineapple model.
为直观展示各评估算法在检测精度与模型规模之间的权衡关系，图 10 呈现了参数量与 mAP@0.5:0.95（图 10(a)）及 mAP@0.5（图 10(b)）的对应关系。理想情况下，最优模型应位于左上象限，即兼具高精度与最少参数量。如图所示，所提模型（以红色星号标示）在所有对比模型中占据最有利位置。尽管 YOLOv9（以浅绿色三角标示）在横轴上略偏左侧，但其纵轴位置偏低，反映出在模型规模小幅缩减的同时，定位精度显著下降。相比之下，所提模型在精度指标上优于 YOLOv11（以粉色菱形标示），同时保持了相近的低参数量。这些图形结果进一步验证了 YOLO-Pineapple 模型的优越性。
