The experimental findings demonstrate that the proposed YOLO-Pineapple model outperforms both conventional two-stage and one-stage detection architectures in the specialized task of detecting small pineapple objects within complex environments. Specifically, the YOLO-Pineapple model attained a Precision of 94.6%, surpassing the second-best performing TOOD model by 5.1%. In terms of Recall, the proposed approach achieved 88.9%, exceeding TOOD by 5%. Regarding localization accuracy, while Cascade R-CNN and TOOD exhibited competitive results with an mAP@0.5 of 89.7%, the proposed method improved upon these by 4.7%. Moreover, for the more rigorous evaluation metric mAP@0.5:0.95, the proposed model achieved 62.9%, outperforming Cascade R-CNN by 3.6%. These outcomes suggest that the introduced DITAH architecture and GMSC mechanism facilitate a more precise alignment between classification and localization tasks compared to the strategies employed in TOOD. Concerning the comprehensive F1-score metric, YOLO-Pineapple reached 91.7%, representing a 5.1% enhancement over TOOD (86.6%) and a substantially greater margin relative to models such as SSD (76.8%) and RetinaNet (84.0%).
实验结果表明，所提出的 YOLO-Pineapple 模型在复杂环境下的小型菠萝目标检测任务中，性能优于传统的两阶段和单阶段检测架构。具体而言，YOLO-Pineapple 模型的精确率达到 94.6%，比排名第二的 TOOD 模型高出 5.1%；召回率达到 88.9%，比 TOOD 模型提升 5%。在定位精度方面，虽然 Cascade R-CNN 和 TOOD 模型在 mAP@0.5 指标上均达到 89.7%的竞争性结果，但本方法在此基础上提升了 4.7%。此外，在更严格的评估指标 mAP@0.5:0.95 上，本模型达到 62.9%，比 Cascade R-CNN 高出 3.6%。这些结果表明，与 TOOD 采用的策略相比，本文提出的 DITAH 架构和 GMSC 机制能够更精确地协调分类与定位任务。在综合 F1 分数指标上，YOLO-Pineapple 达到 91.7%，较 TOOD（86.6%）提升 5.1%，并显著优于 SSD（76.8%）和 RetinaNet（84.0%）等模型。
In summary, traditional single-stage detectors like SSD exhibited limited effectiveness in handling the dense and small-scale features characteristic of UAV-acquired pineapple imagery, achieving an mAP@0.5 of only 78%. Conversely, although two-stage detectors such as Faster R-CNN delivered acceptable accuracy, their reliance on complex region proposal networks entails significantly higher computational demands. The proposed model’s F1-score of 91.7% indicates an optimal balance between Precision and Recall. Collectively, these results provide strong evidence supporting the efficacy of the proposed lightweight framework for small-object pineapple detection in high-resolution UAV imagery.
总之，传统的单阶段检测器（如 SSD）在处理无人机获取的菠萝图像中密集且小尺度的特征时效果有限，其 mAP@0.5 仅为 78%。相比之下，尽管 Faster R-CNN 等两阶段检测器能够提供可接受的精度，但它们依赖于复杂的区域提议网络，导致计算需求显著增加。所提出模型的 F1 分数为 91.7%，表明其在精确率和召回率之间达到了最佳平衡。这些结果共同有力地证明了所提出的轻量级框架在高分辨率无人机图像中检测小目标菠萝的有效性。

3.4. Qualitative visualization analysis
3.4. 定性可视化分析

3.4.1. Heatmap analysis  3.4.1. 热力图分析

To provide a more intuitive demonstration of the proposed model's perception of pineapple objects relative to the baseline, the Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) technique was employed. Fig. 10 presents a comparative visualization between the original YOLOv8 and the enhanced YOLO-Pineapple model under various conditions, such as occlusion and low-light environments. In the resulting heatmaps, regions highlighted in red and yellow correspond to areas of high attention activation, whereas blue regions denote areas of low activation.
为了更直观地展示所提模型相较于基线模型对菠萝目标的感知能力，采用了梯度加权类激活映射（Grad-CAM）技术。图 10 展示了原始 YOLOv8 与改进后的 YOLO-Pineapple 模型在遮挡、弱光等多种条件下的对比可视化结果。在生成的热力图中，红色和黄色区域对应高注意力激活区域，而蓝色区域则表示低激活区域。
As illustrated in Fig. 11(b), the baseline YOLOv8 model exhibited dispersed and indistinct attention distributions. The regions of high activation were diffusely spread across the pineapple leaves and surrounding vegetation rather than being concentrated on the pineapple fruit itself. This dispersion indicates that the baseline model struggles to distinguish pineapples from visually similar background elements, leading to false positives and missed detections. Conversely, the YOLO-Pineapple model produced heatmaps with highly focused and coherent activation patterns (Fig. 11(c)), with activation hotspots predominantly centered on the fruit. This finding underscores the efficacy of the Spatial-Channel Self-Attention (SCSA) mechanism, which integrates spatial and channel features to enhance pineapple texture representation while suppressing background interference.
如图 11(b)所示，基准 YOLOv8 模型呈现出分散且模糊的注意力分布。高激活区域广泛分布在菠萝叶片及周边植被上，而非集中于菠萝果实本身。这种分散性表明基准模型难以将菠萝与视觉相似的背景元素区分开来，从而导致误检和漏检。相比之下，YOLO-Pineapple 模型生成的注意力热图呈现出高度聚焦且连贯的激活模式（图 11(c)），激活热点主要集中于果实区域。这一发现凸显了空间-通道自注意力（SCSA）机制的有效性，该机制通过整合空间与通道特征，在抑制背景干扰的同时增强了菠萝纹理表征能力。
Importantly, under challenging low-light conditions (depicted in the fourth column of Fig. 11), the baseline YOLOv8 model failed to generate meaningful activations, indicating a limited capacity for reliable feature extraction. In contrast, the YOLO-Pineapple model maintained robust feature extraction performance despite insufficient illumination. This improvement is attributed to the incorporation of the Global Multi-Scale Context (GMSC) module alongside the SCSA mechanism, which collectively mitigate background noise and reinforce the semantic representation of pineapple objects across diverse and complex environmental scenarios. However, while the heatmaps provide intuitive evidence of the model's focus on pineapple fruits, this analysis remains primarily qualitative. A quantitative assessment of attention localization accuracy was not performed due to the absence of pixel-level segmentation masks in the current dataset. Future research could incorporate quantitative analyses to facilitate a more rigorous evaluation of the detection results.
重要的是，在具有挑战性的低光照条件下（如图 11 第四列所示），基线 YOLOv8 模型未能生成有意义的激活图，表明其可靠特征提取能力有限。相比之下，YOLO-Pineapple 模型在光照不足的情况下仍保持了稳健的特征提取性能。这一改进归因于全局多尺度上下文（GMSC）模块与 SCSA 机制的整合，二者共同抑制了背景噪声，并在多样化的复杂环境场景中强化了菠萝目标的语义表征。然而，尽管热力图提供了模型聚焦于菠萝果实的直观证据，该分析仍主要停留在定性层面。由于当前数据集缺乏像素级分割掩码，未对注意力定位精度进行定量评估。未来研究可纳入定量分析，以促进对检测结果更严格的评估。

3.4.2. Detection performance in complex field scenarios
3.4.2. 复杂田间场景下的检测性能

To evaluate the generalizability of the proposed model in natural field environments, we conducted an additional assessment of its detection performance across three challenging conditions: variable illumination, dense occlusion, and backgrounds with high similarity. A comparative visualization of the results obtained from the baseline YOLOv8 and the proposed approach is presented in Fig. 12.
为评估所提模型在自然田间环境中的泛化能力，我们针对三种具有挑战性的场景（光照变化、密集遮挡及高相似度背景）额外开展了检测性能评估。图 12 展示了基线 YOLOv8 与所提方法的可视化对比结果。
As demonstrated under front-light conditions (Fig. 12(a)), intense sunlight reflections on the ground led the original YOLOv8 model to erroneously classify ground patches as pineapples, resulting in false positives. In contrast, the proposed model effectively filtered out lighting-induced noise, thereby achieving robust detection performance. Similarly, under back-light conditions (Fig. 12(b)), YOLO-Pineapple maintained high detection confidence despite variations in illumination. Moreover, in scenarios characterized by high object density (Fig. 12(c)), small pineapples partially occluded by leaves were frequently overlooked by the baseline model. By integrating the DITAH architecture, which enhances task alignment, and the GMSC, which provides multi-scale feature representation, the proposed model successfully recovered these small, occluded targets, leading to a significant improvement in Recall rates. Furthermore, as illustrated in Fig. 12(c), (d), and (e), YOLOv8 exhibited a tendency to misclassify dense foliage and weeds as pineapples due to the high similarity in texture and color between the fruit, its crown, and surrounding vegetation. In contrast, leveraging the SCSA attention mechanism alongside the Focaler_SIoU loss function, the proposed model effectively concentrated on challenging samples and learned subtle discriminative features, thereby enhancing its ability to distinguish objects from background clutter.
如图 12(a)所示，在正面光照条件下，地面强烈的阳光反射导致原始 YOLOv8 模型将地面斑块误判为菠萝，产生误检。相比之下，所提模型有效滤除了光照引起的噪声，从而实现了稳健的检测性能。类似地，在逆光条件下（图 12(b)），YOLO-Pineapple 在光照变化时仍保持较高的检测置信度。此外，在目标密集的场景中（图 12(c)），被叶片部分遮挡的小菠萝常被基线模型遗漏。通过集成增强任务对齐的 DITAH 架构和提供多尺度特征表征的 GMSC 模块，所提模型成功恢复了这些被遮挡的小目标，显著提升了召回率。如图 12(c)、(d)和(e)所示，由于菠萝果实、冠层与周围植被在纹理和颜色上高度相似，YOLOv8 倾向于将茂密枝叶和杂草误判为菠萝。 相比之下，所提出的模型通过结合 SCSA 注意力机制与 Focaler_SIoU 损失函数，有效聚焦于困难样本并学习细微的判别特征，从而增强了从背景杂波中区分目标的能力。
In summary, the qualitative results indicate that YOLO-Pineapple achieves superior localization accuracy and greater robustness to noise compared to the original YOLOv8, thereby confirming its reliability for high-throughput pineapple detection in UAV imagery captured under natural field conditions.
总之，定性结果表明，与原始 YOLOv8 相比，YOLO-Pineapple 实现了更优的定位精度和更强的噪声鲁棒性，从而证实了其在自然田间条件下无人机影像中进行高通量菠萝检测的可靠性。

4. Discussion  4. 讨论

4.1. Detection robustness in complex field environments
4.1. 复杂田间环境下的检测鲁棒性

The primary challenges associated with UAV-based pineapple detection encompass significant scale variability, wherein individual pineapples typically occupy only 20 to 80 pixels at standard flight altitudes, substantial occlusion resulting from overlapping canopy structures, pronounced visual similarity between the fruits and adjacent foliage, and fluctuating illumination conditions. The proposed YOLO-Pineapple model achieves a mean Average Precision at an Intersection over Union threshold of 0.5 (mAP@0.5) of 94.4% and a precision of 94.6%, thereby demonstrating enhanced robustness relative to the original YOLOv8 architecture and its variants. This improved performance is attributed to the integration of the Dynamic Interaction Task Alignment Head (DITAH), Grouped Multi-Scale Convolution (GMSC), Spatial-Channel Self-Attention (SCSA), and the Focaler_SIoU loss function.
基于无人机平台的菠萝检测面临的主要挑战包括：显著的尺度差异（标准飞行高度下单个菠萝通常仅占 20 至 80 像素）、冠层重叠结构导致的严重遮挡、果实与邻近叶片间显著的视觉相似性，以及光照条件波动。所提出的 YOLO-Pineapple 模型在交并比阈值为 0.5 时的平均精度均值（mAP@0.5）达到 94.4%，精确率达 94.6%，相较于原始 YOLOv8 架构及其变体展现出更强的鲁棒性。这一性能提升归功于动态交互任务对齐头（DITAH）、分组多尺度卷积（GMSC）、空间通道自注意力（SCSA）以及 Focaler_SIoU 损失函数的集成应用。
A critical limitation undermining robustness in dense crop detection is task misalignment, a structural deficiency prevalent in conventional one-stage detectors. In such models, spatial features most informative for classification—such as the texture of the pineapple crown—often lack spatial correspondence with features essential for accurate bounding box regression, for example, the geometric center of the pineapple body. This misalignment is particularly noticeable in densely planted pineapple fields, where extensive leaf overlap causes complex visual patterns that obscure fruit boundaries and reduce the accuracy of bounding box regression. Hence, detectors may correctly identify the presence of pineapples but fail to localize them with sufficient Intersection over Union (IoU) to be considered true positives. The proposed DITAH addresses this issue through a dynamic interaction mechanism. Specifically, task decomposition blocks construct independent feature subspaces dedicated to classification and localization, while preserving a pathway for feature interaction via Group Normalization-based layers. This architectural design enables the model to maintain translation invariance necessary for robust classification—recognizing pineapples irrespective of spatial position—while concurrently ensuring translation equivariance for precise localization, such that predicted bounding boxes consistently correspond to the movement of the target object.
在密集作物检测中，一个严重制约模型鲁棒性的关键缺陷是任务错位——这是传统单阶段检测器中普遍存在的结构性不足。在这类模型中，对分类最具判别力的空间特征（如菠萝冠部的纹理）往往与精确边界框回归所需的关键特征（如菠萝果实的几何中心）缺乏空间对应关系。这种错位在密植菠萝田中尤为显著，大量叶片重叠形成的复杂视觉模式会模糊果实边界，降低边界框回归的精度。因此，检测器可能正确识别菠萝的存在，但无法以足够的交并比（IoU）进行准确定位，导致无法被判定为真正例。本文提出的 DITAH 通过动态交互机制解决了该问题：任务分解模块构建了专用于分类和定位的独立特征子空间，同时通过基于组归一化的层保留特征交互通道。 这种架构设计使模型能够保持鲁棒分类所需的平移不变性——无论菠萝处于何种空间位置都能准确识别——同时确保精确定位所需的平移等变性，使得预测边界框始终与目标物体的移动保持一致。
TOOD (Feng et al., 2021) attempts to mitigate task misalignment, but on the pineapple dataset it achieved only 89.5% precision and an 86.6% F1-score, which is inferior to YOLO-Pineapple’s performance, which achieves a precision of 94.6% and an F1-score of 91.7%. This outcome suggests that DITAH’s capacity to fuse independent features with interactive cues prior to final prediction more effectively resolves the visual similarity between pineapple crowns and fruit bodies than the alignment metrics employed by TOOD. Furthermore, in comparison to the RT-DETR head utilized in DPD-YOLO (Lin et al., 2025), which leverages transformer-based global attention for object query modeling, DITAH provides a convolutional neural network (CNN)-based solution better suited to the specific challenges of UAV-based pineapple detection.
TOOD（Feng 等，2021）试图缓解任务错位问题，但在菠萝数据集上仅达到 89.5%的精确率和 86.6%的 F1 分数，低于 YOLO-Pineapple 的 94.6%精确率和 91.7%F1 分数。这一结果表明，DITAH 在最终预测前将独立特征与交互线索融合的能力，比 TOOD 采用的对齐指标更有效地解决了菠萝冠芽与果实主体之间的视觉相似性问题。此外，与 DPD-YOLO（Lin 等，2025）中利用基于 Transformer 的全局注意力进行目标查询建模的 RT-DETR 头部相比，DITAH 提供了更适合无人机菠萝检测特定挑战的卷积神经网络（CNN）解决方案。
The detection of small objects continues to present a significant challenge in UAV-based remote sensing applications. The proposed YOLO-Pineapple model addresses this issue by incorporating the GMSC within the bottleneck architecture. This module utilizes parallel convolutions with varying kernel sizes and subsequently fuses their outputs, enabling the model to capture both local texture details and broader contextual semantics. Such multi-scale feature extraction is essential for accommodating the size variability of target objects in UAV imagery. In comparison, the DPD-YOLO model (Lin et al., 2025), which employs a BiFPN to manage scale variation, achieved a Recall rate of 62.0%, whereas YOLO-Pineapple attained a substantially higher Recall of 88.9%. This disparity suggests that although BiFPN effectively integrates features across layers, it is limited in its capacity to recover information lost during early feature extraction stages. Conversely, the GMSC operates at the feature generation phase, thereby preserving small-object information before it is propagated through the neck and detection head. This finding aligns with observations in maize seedling detection, where the inclusion of dedicated small-object detection layers (P2) was necessary to capture fine details of emerging plants (Yu et al., 2025). Furthermore, the integration of the SCSA module within YOLO-Pineapple enhances the model’s ability to suppress noise arising from the visual similarity between pineapple crowns and adjacent foliage. Unlike the Coordinate Attention (CA) mechanism employed in ESLC-YOLOv8 (Shen et al., 2025) and DPD-YOLO (Lin et al., 2025), which encodes positional information into channel-wise weights, the SCSA module explicitly models the joint interactions between spatial structures and channel semantics. This approach effectively mitigates background noise, which was a notable source of false positives in the baseline YOLOv8 model.
在无人机遥感应用中，小目标检测始终是重大挑战。本文提出的 YOLO-Pineapple 模型通过在瓶颈架构中引入 GMSC 模块解决了该问题。该模块利用不同尺寸的并行卷积核进行特征提取，随后融合多尺度输出，使模型既能捕捉局部纹理细节，又能获取更广泛的上下文语义信息。这种多尺度特征提取机制对于适应无人机影像中目标物体的尺寸差异至关重要。相比之下，采用 BiFPN 处理尺度变化的 DPD-YOLO 模型（Lin 等，2025）召回率为 62.0%，而 YOLO-Pineapple 达到了 88.9%的显著更高召回率。这种差异表明，虽然 BiFPN 能有效整合跨层特征，但其在恢复早期特征提取阶段丢失信息的能力有限。而 GMSC 在特征生成阶段即开始运作，从而在信息传递至颈部网络和检测头之前就保留了小目标信息。 这一发现与玉米幼苗检测中的观察结果一致，即在检测中需要加入专门的小目标检测层（P2）才能捕捉到新生植株的精细细节（Yu 等，2025）。此外，YOLO-Pineapple 中集成的 SCSA 模块增强了模型抑制噪声的能力，这些噪声源于菠萝冠芽与邻近叶片在视觉上的相似性。与 ESLC-YOLOv8（Shen 等，2025）和 DPD-YOLO（Lin 等，2025）中采用的坐标注意力（CA）机制（该机制将位置信息编码为通道权重）不同，SCSA 模块显式地建模了空间结构与通道语义之间的联合交互作用。 这种方法有效减轻了背景噪声的影响，而背景噪声正是基线 YOLOv8 模型中误报的一个显著来源。
Finally, the robustness of bounding box regression constitutes a critical determinant of detection accuracy. The incorporation of Focaler_SIoU—a hybrid loss function combining the angle-aware geometric constraints of SIoU with a hard sample emphasis mechanism—enhances the model’s localization capabilities. The angle cost component is particularly pertinent for pineapple counting, given that the objects appear as small, near-circular entities in nadir UAV imagery. This improvement in localization precision is reflected in the superior mean Average Precision (mAP@0.5:0.95) of YOLO-Pineapple (62.9%) relative to the 58.8% achieved by TOOD. Such precise localization is essential for downstream tasks, including yield estimation and harvesting operations.
最后，边界框回归的鲁棒性是决定检测精度的关键因素。引入 Focaler_SIoU——一种结合了 SIoU 角度感知几何约束与难样本强调机制的混合损失函数——增强了模型的定位能力。在无人机正射影像中，目标呈现为小型近圆形实体，因此角度成本分量对于菠萝计数尤为重要。这种定位精度的提升体现在 YOLO-Pineapple 的平均精度均值（mAP@0.5:0.95）达到 62.9%，优于 TOOD 的 58.8%。如此精确的定位对于产量估算和采收作业等下游任务至关重要。

4.2. Trade-off analysis between accuracy and computational efficiency
4.2. 精度与计算效率之间的权衡分析

In the context of utilizing UAV for pineapple counting, it is imperative to strike an optimal balance between detection accuracy and computational efficiency. UAV platforms are inherently constrained by factors such as limited battery life, payload capacity, and onboard computational resources. Consequently, deploying models that achieve high detection accuracy at the expense of substantial computational overhead is impractical for real-time applications, as increased latency and power consumption can reduce flight duration and compromise data collection. The YOLO-Pineapple model demonstrates a highly efficient architecture, characterized by a compact model size of 4.54 MB and comprising 2.22 million parameters. In comparison to the original YOLOv8n, which has a model size of 5.99 MB and 3 million parameters, YOLO-Pineapple achieves approximately a 26% reduction in parameter count while simultaneously enhancing the mean average precision at an intersection-over-union threshold of 0.5 (mAP@0.5) from 92.3% to 94.4%. This balance between accuracy and efficiency underscores the effectiveness of the module replacement strategies employed, notably the integration of the GMSC and DITAH components.
在利用无人机进行菠萝计数的场景中，必须在检测精度与计算效率之间实现最优平衡。无人机平台本身受限于电池续航、有效载荷及机载计算资源等因素。因此，若模型以牺牲大量计算开销为代价来追求高检测精度，将难以满足实时应用需求——因为延迟增加和能耗上升会缩短飞行时长并影响数据采集质量。YOLO-Pineapple 模型展现出高度高效的架构特性，其模型体积仅为 4.54 MB，参数量为 222 万。 与原始 YOLOv8n（模型大小为 5.99 MB，参数数量为 300 万）相比，YOLO-Pineapple 在参数数量上减少了约 26%，同时将交并比阈值为 0.5 时的平均精度均值（mAP@0.5）从 92.3%提升至 94.4%。这种精度与效率之间的平衡凸显了所采用的模块替换策略的有效性，尤其是 GMSC 和 DITAH 组件的集成。
The efficiency advantage of YOLO-Pineapple becomes even more pronounced when compared to the DPD-YOLO model, which incorporates the RT-DETR head and BiFPN architecture. DPD-YOLO has a substantially larger model size of 20.1 MB and achieves an mAP@0.5 of 62.0% on its respective dataset. Although direct accuracy comparisons across different datasets should be approached with caution, the disparity in model size indicates that YOLO-Pineapple is approximately 4.4 times more storage-efficient. Furthermore, ablation studies reveal that the inclusion of the DITAH reduces the parameter count from 3.00 million to 2.24 million. This reduction is attributed to DITAH’s replacement of the original, redundant coupled head of YOLOv8 with a more streamlined, task-decomposed architecture that leverages shared interactive features rather than separate, computationally intensive convolutional branches for individual tasks. The DITAH thus represents a more lightweight approach to feature refinement compared to the Transformer-based encoder-decoder structure employed in RT-DETR. Additionally, YOLO-Pineapple surpasses YOLOv11 in terms of precision (94.6% versus 94.0%) and mAP@0.5 (94.4% versus 93.4%) while utilizing fewer parameters. This suggests that task-specific optimizations, such as the implementation of SCSA and DITAH, provide superior performance benefits relative to the general enhancements introduced in recent YOLO iterations. Although YOLOv9 achieves a lower parameter count (1.97 million) and smaller model size (4.46 MB) through its Programmable Gradient Information (PGI) strategy, this efficiency gain is accompanied by a reduction in accuracy (mAP@0.5 of 93.0% compared to 94.4% for YOLO-Pineapple).
与采用 RT-DETR 检测头和 BiFPN 架构的 DPD-YOLO 模型相比，YOLO-Pineapple 的效率优势更为显著。DPD-YOLO 模型体积较大（20.1 MB），在其对应数据集上 mAP@0.5 达到 62.0%。尽管不同数据集间的精度对比需谨慎对待，但模型体积的差异表明 YOLO-Pineapple 的存储效率约为前者的 4.4 倍。此外，消融实验显示，引入 DITAH 模块使参数量从 300 万降至 224 万。这一缩减源于 DITAH 将 YOLOv8 原始冗余的耦合检测头替换为更精简的任务解耦架构——该架构利用共享交互特征，而非为各任务分别设置计算密集的独立卷积分支。相较于 RT-DETR 采用的基于 Transformer 的编码器-解码器结构，DITAH 在特征优化方面实现了更轻量化的方案。 此外，YOLO-Pineapple 在精度（94.6%对比 94.0%）和 mAP@0.5（94.4%对比 93.4%）方面均超越 YOLOv11，同时使用了更少的参数。这表明，针对特定任务的优化（如 SCSA 和 DITAH 模块的应用）相较于近期 YOLO 版本引入的通用改进，能带来更优越的性能提升。尽管 YOLOv9 通过其可编程梯度信息（PGI）策略实现了更低的参数量（197 万）和更小的模型体积（4.46 MB），但这种效率提升是以精度下降为代价的（mAP@0.5 为 93.0%，而 YOLO-Pineapple 为 94.4%）。
In conclusion, the trade-off analysis positions YOLO-Pineapple as an optimal solution for UAV-based pineapple counting tasks. It effectively circumvents the computational demands associated with two-stage detectors while preserving high detection accuracy, a critical requirement for precision agriculture applications.
综上所述，权衡分析表明，YOLO-Pineapple 是无人机菠萝计数任务的最优解决方案。它有效规避了两阶段检测器带来的计算负担，同时保持了高检测精度，而这正是精准农业应用的关键要求。

4.3. Limitations and prospect
4.3. 局限性与展望

Although YOLO-Pineapple demonstrates promising performance, the model exhibits several limitations. Firstly, the dataset employed in this study was collected exclusively from a single geographic location (Xuwen County) during a specific phenological stage. While data augmentation techniques were applied to increase the number of training samples, the underlying data distribution remains constrained both geographically and biologically. Furthermore, the model’s generalizability to other pineapple cultivars has yet to be established. Variations in crown morphology, fruit coloration, and leaf serration among different varieties may influence feature extraction and attention mechanisms. Future research should focus on developing a comprehensive dataset encompassing multiple regions and pineapple varieties. Approaches such as few-shot learning or unsupervised domain adaptation could facilitate model adaptation to novel field conditions with minimal manual annotation. Secondly, despite improvements achieved through the incorporation of various components, the detection framework is fundamentally limited by its reliance on two-dimensional, nadir-view RGB imagery. In cases of severe occlusion, where pineapple fruits are entirely obscured by overlapping foliage, the visual information is absent from the sensor data. To overcome this challenge, integrating Structure-from-Motion (SfM) photogrammetry or LiDAR sensing could provide three-dimensional canopy reconstructions, offering complementary depth information unavailable in RGB images and serving as indirect indicators of occluded fruits. Thirdly, although the model is lightweight, it has not yet been deployed or evaluated on edge computing platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson for onboard UAV operation. Subsequent studies should aim to implement the model on such embedded systems to assess its real-time operational efficiency during flight. Thirdly, this study primarily focuses on pineapple detection at a consistent Ground Sampling Distance (GSD), as the UAV imagery was acquired at a fixed flight altitude. Consequently, the targets in the dataset exhibit a relatively concentrated scale distribution, mostly falling into the small category. Future work could involve collecting multi-altitude data to perform a systematic sensitivity analysis of detection performance relative to target pixel resolution, further verifying the model’s robustness in diverse operational scenarios. Finally, the current framework is primarily focused on object detection and counting, whereas modern precision agriculture increasingly demands insights into crop physiological status, including health, maturity, and stress conditions. RGB imagery alone is insufficient for capturing these internal physiological indicators. A promising direction for future work involves the integration of multimodal sensor data, such as multispectral or hyperspectral imaging, to augment spatial detection with biologically relevant spectral information. For instance, integrating the Near-Infrared (NIR) band or calculating the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) could enhance the contrast between the pineapple fruit and the canopy, leveraging the distinct spectral signatures of fruiting bodies compared to vegetative foliage to reduce false positives in visually similar backgrounds.
尽管 YOLO-Pineapple 展现出良好的性能，但该模型仍存在若干局限性。首先，本研究使用的数据集仅采集自单一地理区域（徐闻县）的特定物候期。虽然通过数据增强技术增加了训练样本数量，但底层数据分布仍受限于地理和生物学维度。此外，该模型对其他菠萝品种的泛化能力尚未得到验证。不同品种在冠层形态、果实着色和叶缘锯齿等方面的差异可能影响特征提取与注意力机制。未来研究应着力构建涵盖多区域、多品种菠萝的综合数据集，通过小样本学习或无监督域适应等方法，在最小化人工标注的前提下实现模型对新田间条件的自适应。其次，尽管通过集成多种组件提升了检测性能，但该检测框架本质上仍受限于对二维天底视角 RGB 图像的依赖。 在严重遮挡的情况下，菠萝果实完全被重叠的叶片覆盖，传感器数据中缺乏视觉信息。为应对这一挑战，结合运动恢复结构（SfM）摄影测量或激光雷达（LiDAR）传感技术可提供三维冠层重建，从而补充 RGB 图像中缺失的深度信息，并作为遮挡果实的间接指示指标。第三，尽管模型轻量化，但尚未在 NVIDIA Jetson 等边缘计算平台上部署或评估其机载无人机运行性能。后续研究应将该模型部署于此类嵌入式系统，以评估其在飞行过程中的实时运行效率。此外，本研究主要关注固定地面采样距离（GSD）下的菠萝检测，因为无人机影像是在固定飞行高度下采集的。因此，数据集中的目标尺度分布相对集中，大多属于小目标类别。 未来工作可涉及采集多高度数据，系统分析检测性能对目标像素分辨率的敏感性，进一步验证模型在不同作业场景下的鲁棒性。此外，当前框架主要聚焦于目标检测与计数，而现代精准农业日益需要获取作物生理状态信息，包括健康度、成熟度及胁迫状况。仅凭 RGB 影像无法捕捉这些内部生理指标。未来研究的一个重要方向是整合多模态传感器数据（如多光谱或高光谱成像），将空间检测与生物相关光谱信息相结合。例如，集成近红外波段或计算归一化植被指数，可增强菠萝果实与冠层之间的对比度，利用果实与营养叶片不同的光谱特征，在视觉相似的背景中减少误检。

5. Conclusions  5. 结论

To address the challenges associated with pineapple detection in UAV imagery—such as small object size, leaf occlusion, and background clutter—this study introduces an enhanced YOLO-Pineapple model. Initially, the proposed DITAH architecture effectively leverages interactive features between classification and localization tasks. By integrating these with independent features processed via task decomposition and alignment modules, the model’s localization performance in complex backgrounds is significantly improved. Furthermore, the GMSC replaces the traditional CBS module within the Bottleneck structure, thereby reducing redundant feature extraction while capturing multi-scale information. This modification enables the model to allocate less attention to occluded regions and more to pineapple-specific features, resulting in enhanced detection recall. Additionally, the SCSA mechanism addresses semantic discrepancies between features through collaborative multi-semantic spatial modeling combined with channel-wise self-attention. Lastly, the incorporation of the Focaler mechanism alongside the SIoU loss function allows the model to prioritize the detection of hard-to-recognize pineapples in complex scenes. Collectively, these modules not only enhance detection accuracy but also reduce the number of parameters and overall model size. Comparative evaluations with other object detection frameworks demonstrate that the improved model achieves an optimal balance among detection accuracy, parameter efficiency, and model compactness. By providing reliable high-throughput pineapple counting, this framework enables potential applications in yield prediction and intelligent field management, ultimately enhancing the operational efficiency of pineapple cultivation.
针对无人机影像中菠萝检测面临的小目标、叶片遮挡及背景杂乱等挑战，本研究提出了一种增强型 YOLO-Pineapple 模型。首先，所提出的 DITAH 架构有效利用了分类与定位任务间的交互特征。通过将这些交互特征与经任务分解和对齐模块处理的独立特征相融合，模型在复杂背景下的定位性能得到显著提升。其次，GMSC 模块替代了 Bottleneck 结构中的传统 CBS 模块，在捕获多尺度信息的同时减少了冗余特征提取。这一改进使模型能够减少对遮挡区域的关注，而将更多注意力集中于菠萝特征，从而提升了检测召回率。此外，SCSA 机制通过协同多语义空间建模与通道自注意力，有效解决了特征间的语义差异问题。 最后，Focaler 机制与 SIoU 损失函数的结合使模型能够在复杂场景中优先检测难以识别的菠萝。这些模块共同作用，不仅提升了检测精度，还减少了参数量和模型整体大小。与其他目标检测框架的对比评估表明，改进后的模型在检测精度、参数效率和模型紧凑性之间实现了最佳平衡。 通过提供可靠的高通量菠萝计数，该框架在产量预测和智能田间管理中具有潜在应用价值，最终提升了菠萝种植的运营效率。
